verses.text: Then Job answered:
“How long will you torment me and crush me with your words?

xrefs.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

verses.text: Ten times now you have reproached me; you shamelessly mistreat me.

xrefs.text: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, God has not allowed him to harm me.
My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.
In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king consulted them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.
At that time the Jews who lived nearby came and told us ten times over, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”
Are the consolations of God not enough for you, even words spoken gently to you?

verses.text: Even if I have truly gone astray, my error concerns me alone.

xrefs.text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.
Behold, every soul belongs to Me; both father and son are Mine. The soul who sins is the one who will die.

When David saw the angel striking down the people, he said to the LORD, “Surely I, the shepherd, have sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? Please, let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house.”
For each one should carry his own load.

verses.text: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace against me,

xrefs.text: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
They replied, “You were born in utter sin, and you are instructing us? And they threw him out.
The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.

verses.text: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.

xrefs.text: For his own feet lead him into a net, and he wanders into its mesh.
If I have sinned, what have I done to You, O watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to You
“As surely as God lives, who has deprived me of justice— the Almighty, who has embittered my soul—
God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples, and they will draw you up in My net.

verses.text: Though I cry out, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.

xrefs.text: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
For Job has declared, ‘I am righteous, yet God has deprived me of justice.
Behold, I know your thoughts full well, the schemes by which you would wrong me.
I cry out to You for help, but You do not answer; when I stand up, You merely look at me.

verses.text: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.

xrefs.text: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they do not know what makes them stumble.
You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.

verses.text: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.

xrefs.text: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
When I went out to the city gate and took my seat in the public square,
You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
He leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges.
The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

verses.text: He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.

xrefs.text: The womb forgets them; the worm feeds on them; they are remembered no more. So injustice is broken like a tree.
I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.

verses.text: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.

xrefs.text: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.
Yet God finds occasions against me; He counts me as His enemy.
The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.

verses.text: His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.

xrefs.text: The rabble arises at my right; they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps against me.
His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.
God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.”
Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger; the staff in their hands is My wrath.

verses.text: He has removed my brothers from me; my acquaintances have abandoned me.

xrefs.text: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.

verses.text: My kinsmen have failed me, and my friends have forgotten me.

xrefs.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother.
Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.

For I have heard the whispering of many: “Terror is on every side! Report him; let us report him!” All my trusted friends watch for my fall: “Perhaps he will be deceived so that we may prevail against him and take our vengeance upon him.”
I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’

verses.text: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.

xrefs.text: if the men of my house have not said, ‘Who is there who has not had his fill?’—
Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.

verses.text: I call for my servant, but he does not answer, though I implore him with my own mouth.

xrefs.text: the Sabeans swooped down and took them away. They put the servants to the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you!”
when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on the young people and they are dead, and I alone have escaped to tell you!”

verses.text: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.

xrefs.text: Then Job’s wife said to him, “Do you still retain your integrity? Curse God and die!”
[“]My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; the grave awaits me.

verses.text: Even little boys scorn me; when I appear, they deride me.

xrefs.text: From there, Elisha went up to Bethel, and as he was walking up the road, a group of boys came out of the city and jeered at him, chanting, “Go up, you baldhead! Go up, you baldhead!”
[“]But now they mock me, men younger than I am, whose fathers I would have refused to put with my sheep dogs.
The rabble arises at my right; they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps against me.
The people will oppress one another, man against man, neighbor against neighbor; the young will rise up against the old, and the base against the honorable.

verses.text: All my best friends despise me, and those I love have turned against me.

xrefs.text: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?
A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

verses.text: My skin and flesh cling to my bones; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

xrefs.text: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
A man is also chastened on his bed with pain and constant distress in his bones,
There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.

verses.text: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.

xrefs.text: But stretch out Your hand and strike all that he has, and he will surely curse You to Your face.”
For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.

verses.text: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?

xrefs.text: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
Should I hold my head high, You would hunt me like a lion, and again display Your power against me.
God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.”
Would You frighten a windblown leaf? Would You chase after dry chaff?

verses.text: I wish that my words were recorded and inscribed in a book,

xrefs.text: Go now, write it on a tablet in their presence and inscribe it on a scroll; it will be for the days to come, a witness forever and ever.
(Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature. Let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser compose an indictment.
Then the LORD said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary stylus: Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

verses.text: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.

xrefs.text: [“]The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, engraved with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and coat them with plaster.
And you shall write distinctly upon these stones all the words of this law.”
The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

verses.text: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.

xrefs.text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you.

verses.text: Even after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God.

xrefs.text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him— even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

verses.text: I will see Him for myself; my eyes will behold Him, and not as a stranger. How my heart yearns within me!

xrefs.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.

verses.text: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him,

xrefs.text: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?
For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.

All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. For this is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will receive a proper burial, because only in him has the LORD, the God of Israel, found any good in the house of Jeroboam.

verses.text: then you should fear the sword yourselves, because wrath brings punishment by the sword, so that you may know there is a judgment.”

xrefs.text: For God will bring every deed into judgment, along with every hidden thing, whether good or evil.

Rejoice, O young man, while you are young, and let your heart be glad in the days of your youth. Walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes, but know that for all these things God will bring you to judgment.
But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
[“]Do not judge, or you will be judged.
The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
